grades.quote: This chapter describes the machine-level operations available in machine-mode (M-mode), which is the highest privilege mode in a RISC-V hart. M-mode is used for low-level access to a hardware platform and is the first mode entered at reset. M-mode can also be used to implement features that are too difficult or expensive to implement in hardware directly.
grades.reason: Explains M-mode's purpose and software roles, but not S-mode or U-mode.

grades.quote: In addition to the machine-level CSRs described in this section, M-mode code can access all CSRs at lower privilege levels.
grades.reason: Provides an M-mode privilege capability, but does not explain the intended roles of the three modes.
